SKILLED TRADES/INDIRECT LABOR AUDITS

It is intended that these skilled trades audits will be conducted at plant locations when requested by either of the local parties or the Group/Divisional Labor Relations Director or International Union Regional or GM Department Servicing Representative. Prior to conducting a joint audit, all appropriate documentation must be submitted to the National Parties.
